{{Quote|Generals, I regret to inform you that the situation here is grave. While my people remain loyal to the Republic, the Separatists are making advances on the system, and may soon threaten our home planet.|King Yos Kolina, to Generals Plo Koon and Anakin Skywalker|<ref name="CWA">[[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']]</ref>}}
The '''Mission to Iceberg Three''' occurred in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], following [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous's]] [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] invasion of the [[Mon Calamari system/Legends|Calamari system]]. In response to this, the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] dispatched [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]], [[Wolffe/Legends|Wolffe]], and a [[Unidentified Jedi Knight (Clone Wars)|Jedi Knight]] to stop the invasion forces on [[Iceberg Three]]. While the attack on Iceberg Three was halted, and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic's]] [[Iceberg Three Republic outpost|outpost]] and the natives of Iceberg Three were saved, the events eventually led to a [[Battle of Mon Cala/Legends|full-scale conflict]] on [[Dac/Legends|Mon Cala]].

==The battle==
{{Quote|The situation here is worse than we expected. Only one planet stands between the Separatists and our base, and we need your help to fight through the enemy fleet.''"<br />"''This got real messy real fast. We need to punch a hole through that invasion fleet so we can reach Iceberg Three in one piece. Are you ready for launch?|Plo Koon and Commander Wolffe to the Jedi Knight prior to the battle|<ref name="CWA" />}}
Shortly after [[King/Legends|King]] [[Yos Kolina/Legends|Yos Kolina]] spoke with [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], the [[Iceberg Three Republic outpost|Republic outpost]] on [[Iceberg Three]] reported a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] was within attack range. The [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] responded by sending a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] fleet led by [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] Koon and [[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Wolffe/Legends|Wolffe]], but upon arrival, they found out that the Separatists had already [[Blockade/Legends|blockaded]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. Koon turned to [[Unidentified Jedi Knight (Clone Wars)|the Jedi Knight]], who led a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] attack and managed to punch a hole through the fleet with minimal casualties, and then rendezvoused with Koon at the Republic outpost in sector 327.

Upon arrival, Koon required to make contact with the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] to inform them of the Republic's slipping hold on the [[Mon Calamari system/Legends|Calamari system]], Commander Wolffe and the Jedi Knight took a single [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i gunship]] to the last standing [[Iceberg Three communications tower|communications tower]] on the [[Comet/Legends|comet]], and pushed through the heavy fire of the large amounts of [[Droid/Legends|droid]] forces already on the surface, including [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|''Vulture''-class droid starfighters]], [[Hyena-class bomber/Legends|''Hyena''-class bombers]], [[Droid tri-fighter/Legends|droid tri-fighters]], along with multiple ground units. Once they had relayed the news of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous's]] invasion to the High Council, Wolffe and the Jedi Knight returned to the Republic outpost.

With the battle becoming far too intense, Koon decided to evacuate the natives of the area to the safety of his [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]]. However, General Grievous intended to capture the [[Refugee/Legends|refugees]], and sent many of his forces, including [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|BX-series droid commandos]], [[Single Trooper Aerial Platform/Legends|Single Trooper Aerial Platforms]], [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|Armored Assault Tanks]], [[DSD1 dwarf spider droid/Legends|DSD1 dwarf spider droids]], and [[NR-N99 Persuader-class droid enforcer/Legends|NR-N99 ''Persuader''-class droid enforcers]], in a [[C-9979 landing craft/Legends|C-9979 landing craft]] to stop the [[Transport/Legends|transports]] loaded with the refugees from leaving the planet. To counter it, Wolffe had his [[Engineer/Legends|engineers]] prepare blaster turret defense platforms, and placed them, along with the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] of [[Wolfpack/Legends|Wolfpack]], under the command of the Jedi Knight to stop the droids' advance, while Koon engaged the Separatist fleet in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]]. Wolffe and the troopers of Wolfpack defended the two paths leading to the outpost alongside the Jedi Knight, and only stopping to re-supply with ammunition. Wolffe and the Jedi Knight were able to hold off the invaders long enough for all three waves of the Republic's refugee transports to safely launch from the base.

Once all the droids had been pushed back, and the refugees moved safely, Commander Wolffe prepared a LAAT/i gunship to leave the planet before Grievous could send reinforcements. However, just as the [[104th Battalion/Legends|104th Battalion]] prepared to retreat from Iceberg Three, Grievous landed at the outpost to personally lead his forces to victory. Wolffe and his men left the task of battling Grievous to the Jedi Knight, who managed to [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|defeat]] the Separatist general in a one-on-one [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|lightsaber duel]]. Swiftly defeating him, Grievous retreated to his fleet, as did Wolffe and the Jedi Knight.

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|I regret that I only have sad news to greet you with. King Yos Kolina of the Mon Calamari has been assassinated, and as a result the planet is on the brink of a civil war.|Plo Koon, to the Jedi Knight|<ref name="CWA" />}}
While the droids on Iceberg Three had been repelled, the Republic was not able to expel Grievous's forces from the [[Star system/Legends|system]]. In addition to this, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] soon learned that King Yos Kolina had been [[Assassin/Legends|assassinated]], and consequentially, the tension between the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] and the [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] on [[Dac/Legends|Mon Cala]] had greatly increased, nearing the point of civil war. In response, the Republic sent [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassadors]], [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], to stabilize the conflict. The Confederacy, however, had dispatched an envoy of their own, the [[Karkarodon/Legends|Karkarodon]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] [[Riff Tamson/Legends|Riff Tamson]]. Amidala and Skywalker failed to prevent hostilities, with Tamson provoking the Quarren and rallying them in an assault against the Mon Calamari, leading to the [[Battle of Mon Cala/Legends|Battle of Mon Cala]].
